description_en: Queries the details of the database proxy settings of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的数据库代理设置详情
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-proxy --db-instance-id rm-bp1ja4f56s7us0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBProxy

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to obtain the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A deprecated parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter
parameters.name: db_proxy_engine_type

DBProxyAVZones.description_en: The list of zones where the proxy service is deployed
DBProxyAVZones.description_zh: 代理服务所在的可用区列表

items.description_en: The zone where the proxy service is deployed
items.description_zh: 代理服务所在的可用区

DBProxyConnectStringItems.description_en: The list of database proxy endpoint information
DBProxyConnectStringItems.description_zh: 数据库代理的连接地址信息列表

items.description_en: The details of the database proxy endpoint information
items.description_zh: 数据库代理的连接地址信息详情

DBProxyConnectStringNetType.description_en:
The network type of the proxy endpoint. Valid values:
OuterString: public network
InnerString: internal network
DBProxyConnectStringNetType.description_zh:
代理连接地址的网络类型。
OuterString：外网
InnerString：内网

DBProxyConnectStringNetWorkType.description_en:
The proxy network type. Valid values:
0: Internet
1: classic network
2: virtual private cloud (VPC)
DBProxyConnectStringNetWorkType.description_zh:
代理网络类型。
0：公网
1：经典网络
2：专有网络

DBProxyConnectStringPort.description_en: The port of the proxy endpoint

DBProxyEndpointId.description_en: The ID of the backend proxy endpoint

DBProxyEndpointName.description_en: The name of the proxy endpoint, which is the actual proxy endpoint ID in service
DBProxyEndpointName.description_zh: 代理终端名称，真实服务的代理终端ID

DBProxyVpcId.description_en: The VPC of the proxy service address

DBProxyVpcInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the proxy

DBProxyVswitchId.description_en: The vSwitch of the proxy service address

DBProxyEngineType.description_en: An internal parameter. You can ignore this parameter

DBProxyInstanceCurrentMinorVersion.description_en: The current minor version of the proxy instance

DBProxyInstanceLatestMinorVersion.description_en: The latest minor version of the proxy instance

DBProxyInstanceMinorVersions.description_en: The list of minor versions to which the proxy instance can be upgraded
DBProxyInstanceMinorVersions.description_zh: 代理实例可升级版本集合

items.description_en: The minor version to which the proxy can be upgraded

DBProxyInstanceName.description_en: The name of the proxy instance

DBProxyInstanceNum.description_en: The number of enabled proxy instances

DBProxyInstanceSize.description_en:
This parameter is supported only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL. The actual specification size of the proxy instance.

Format: `CPU/Memory`.

Example: 4/8 indicates 4 CPU cores and 8 GB of memory
DBProxyInstanceSize.description_zh:
该参数仅RDS PostgreSQL支持。表示代理实例规格实际大小。

格式：`CPU/内存`。

例如：4/8表示4核CPU 8GB内存

DBProxyInstanceStatus.description_en:
The running status of the proxy instance. Valid values:
DBInstanceClassChanging: The specification is being changed.
Creating: The instance is being created.
Running: The instance is running.
Deleting: The instance is being deleted
DBProxyInstanceStatus.description_zh:
代理实例的运行状态。
DBInstanceClassChanging：变配中
Creating：创建中
Running：运行中
Deleting：删除中

DBProxyInstanceType.description_en:
The type of the proxy service. Valid values:
1: shared database proxy
2: dedicated database proxy
3: general-purpose database proxy

ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL does not support shared database proxies
DBProxyInstanceType.description_zh:
代理服务类型。
1：共享型代理
2：独享型代理
3：通用型代理

RDS PostgreSQL不支持共享型代理

DBProxyKindCode.description_en: An internal parameter. You can ignore this parameter

items.description_en: The details of the proxy node

cpuCores.description_en: The number of CPU cores of the node

nodeId.description_en: The ID of the proxy node

zoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the node
zoneId.description_zh: 节点所在的可用区 ID

DBProxyPersistentConnectionStatus.description_en:
The persistent connection status. Valid values:
Enabled: Persistent connections are enabled.
Disabled: Persistent connections are disabled.
Unsupported: The instance does not support persistent connections
DBProxyPersistentConnectionStatus.description_zh:
连接保持状态。取值：
Enabled：开启
Disabled：关闭
Unsupported：实例不支持开启连接保持

DBProxyServiceStatus.description_en:
The status of the database proxy feature. Valid values:
Shutdown: disabled
Startup: enabled
DBProxyServiceStatus.description_zh:
数据库代理功能开关状态。
Shutdown：关闭
Startup：开启

DbProxyEndpointItems.description_en: The list of proxy endpoint information

items.description_en: The details of the proxy endpoint

DbProxyEndpointAliases.description_en: The description of the proxy endpoint

DbProxyEndpointName.description_en: The ID of the proxy endpoint

DbProxyEndpointType.description_en:
The type of the proxy endpoint. Valid values:
Custom: custom proxy endpoint
RWSplit: default proxy endpoint
DbProxyEndpointType.description_zh:
代理终端类型。
Custom：自定义代理终端
RWSplit：默认代理终端

DbProxyReadWriteMode.description_en:
The mode of the proxy endpoint. Valid values:
ReadOnly: read-only mode
ReadWrite: read/write mode
DbProxyReadWriteMode.description_zh:
代理终端模式。
ReadOnly：只读模式
ReadWrite：读写模式
